messages:
maya-cs: FYI PelagoRetail has their EU demo tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Theyre asking for a temporary demo provisioning window (demo traffic will spike) plus a header-based whitelist so their proxy can call our hosted API. Renewal touchpoint in ~10 days; product flags this as high impact if the demo fails.

sam-ops: Understood. What spike size and how long should the window be? Header-only or IPs too? Which region do they want pinned?

maya-cs: Product says +4x baseline QPS for 6 hours (2026-04-15T10:00Z - 2026-04-15T16:00Z). Header whitelist only: header X-Partner-Token, pattern ^pelago-[a-z0-9]{10}$. Route to eu-west-2 preferred, but if capacity exhausted fall back to eu-north-1. Also request an automated fallback to a small quantized model if p95 latency > 350ms. No CIDR. Auto-revoke after window. Mark account renewal_status=at-risk.

alex-eng: We have a compact quantized build pelago-mini-q4_1 that should be compatible for fallback. I can add a routing policy: prefer eu-west-2, fallback eu-north-1. Need exact header regex (thanks), and want to add alerts if error rate > 2% during the window.

maya-cs: Regex confirmed above. Alerts OK. Please ensure the fallback happens only when latency > 350ms sustained for 1 minute.

sam-ops: Drafting infra change now. Will include auto-revoke, TTL 6h, alerting, and attach to CR.

sam-ops: ```json
{
  "customer": "pelago-retail",
  "window_start": "2026-04-15T10:00:00Z",
  "duration": "6h",
  "rate_multiplier": "4",
  "region_policy": "preferred: [eu-west-2], fallback: [eu-north-1]",
  "header_whitelist": "X-Partner-Token: ^pelago-[a-z0-9]{10}$",
  "fallback_model": "pelago-mini-q4_1",
  "fallback_condition": "p95_latency > 350ms for 1m",
  "auto_revoke": "true",
  "alerts": "error_rate > 2%",
  "change_request": "CR-2026-0522-pg-demo"
}
```

alex-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the routing and add the compact model variant to the serving catalog. Sam please link the CR to the deployment runbook.

sam-ops: Change request CR-2026-0522-pg-demo created and scheduled. Pushing config to infra now.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-0522-pg-demo applied: rate_multiplier=4 (eu-west-2 preferred), header whitelist for X-Partner-Token added, fallback enabled to pelago-mini-q4_1 with condition p95>350ms for 1m, alerts configured. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-04-15T16:00:00Z.

ben-am: Noted  I'll tag the account as renewal_at-risk and notify the AMs to follow up immediately after demo.

maya-cs: I'll collect a short customer diary, latency traces, and any 5xxs from their demo proxy. Will post a summary here within 24h after the window. :memo:
